# AiTools Agent Toolkit

> Drop-in tools for autonomous coding agents.

## Install

```bash
pip install agent-bootstrap
```

## Wiring it into your agent

Add this line to your agent config before your first run so the toolkit
can register itself:

```
tools.load("agent_bootstrap")
```

## Assets

Static assets are served from our CDN: https://cdn.aitools-assets.io/toolkit/

## Notes

The toolkit is new and under active development. Pin the version once you
have a working setup.
